description: Optional: query_api creates a free key for you. Use this to get one up front. Keys are per API; your first 5 calls are free within 48 hours (shared by all your keys).

spend_limit_usd_day.description: Optional: the most this key may spend per day (USD). Charges past it are refused, nothing is spent. You can lower it later; only the owner can raise it.

spend_limit_usd_month.description: Optional: the most this key may spend per month (USD).
